title: Right to dignity of human person
shortTitle: Right to dignity of human person
question: What does Constitution 1999 section 34 say about right to dignity of human person?
shortAnswer: Constitution 1999 s.34 — No torture, inhuman/degrading treatment; no slavery/forced labour.
legalExplanation:
**Section 34 of the Constitution 1999** provides:

No torture, inhuman/degrading treatment; no slavery/forced labour

This provision empowers Constitution 1999 officers with specific powers and duties.
practicalOptions: Stay calm. Know your rights. Ask for identification. Do not resist. Ask for lawyer. Document everything.
whatToAvoid: Do not run, bribe, resist, destroy evidence, or sign without lawyer.
whatToDocument: Officer name, agency, badge, vehicle, time, location, witnesses, injuries, photos/video.
whatToDoAfter: Get lawyer. File complaint with agency complaints unit or ICPC/PCR. Demand court within 24h. Document injuries.
